title: fake-runner blocked-first mode keys on the run-wide attempt number, not the tick's own
body: testdata/fake-runner.sh's blocked-first (and finding_blocked) modes gate on TICFAC_ATTEMPT = 1, but attempt numbers are run-wide, not per tick. Every current test works only because the fixture dispatches sequentially and a1 always gets number 1; a future test whose tick loses the race for number 1 would silently get DONE-instead-of-BLOCKED behaviour and fail for a reason nobody can read. Keying on the tick's first attempt (e.g. a per-tick env var the harness derives) would make the mode independent of dispatch order.
